label: Enterprise 001 / Real-Time Systems
title: REAL-TIME
PLATFORM
description: A unified communication platform for messaging, video meetings, and digital collaboration. My work focused on asynchronous events, participant states, connection recovery, and responsive interfaces.
highlights: Private and group messaging, replies, mentions, and file sharing.
Video meetings with participant controls, adaptive layouts, breakout rooms, and Picture-in-Picture.
Automatic reconnection, encrypted client-side storage, and meeting state synchronization.

label: Enterprise 002 / Offline-First Systems
title: OFFLINE
ENTERPRISE
description: An enterprise application built around local data persistence and responsive operation without a continuous connection. I worked on encrypted storage, background database processing, and modular frontend architecture.
highlights: Local SQLite and OPFS storage with Web Crypto and AES-GCM encryption.
Background processing and clear repository, service, mapper, and state layers.
Hierarchical data, local assets, permission-aware interfaces, and outbox synchronization design.

label: Enterprise 003 / Access Management
title: ACCESS
CONTROL
description: A permission-aware frontend implementation that keeps navigation, actions, and module behavior consistent with assigned access rights. I centralized permission evaluation and reduced repeated access-checking logic.
highlights: Module and feature-level checks with permission-aware navigation.
Dynamic action visibility, role-aware rendering, and route-to-module mapping.
User administration and activity log interfaces; frontend checks complement server-side authorization.

label: Personal 004 / Browser Game
title: WAR GAME
description: A browser game inspired by the Indonesian independence era. An experiment in game logic, animation, player interaction, statistics, a shop, and background music.
highlights: Browser gameplay and animation.
Player statistics and shop functionality.
